pillar1_coefficient_rationale.death_urgency (1.2): Death overs (16.0-20.0) represent maximum scoring urgency where balls cannot be deferred. High benchmark boundary expectation (~165+ SR).
pillar1_coefficient_rationale.collapse_pressure (0.45): Measures overs remaining per wicket in hand. Captures resource scarcity when wickets fall early, balancing the risk of bowling-out against scoring progression.
pillar1_coefficient_rationale.platform_pressure (0.35): Scales the urgency to break run rate stagnation when the current run rate is depressed below par in the 1st innings.
pillar1_coefficient_rationale.chase_pressure (1.0): Directly reflects required run rate and RR gap in the second innings.
